clauses.title: Govern: cultivate risk management culture
clauses.text: A culture of risk management shall be cultivated and present in AI design, development, deployment, evaluation and acquisition.

clauses.title: Map: context and risks identified
clauses.text: Context for the AI system shall be established and risks identified, mapped to organizational goals and the rights of affected populations.

clauses.title: Measure: identified risks assessed
clauses.text: Identified AI risks shall be analyzed, assessed, benchmarked and monitored using qualitative and quantitative methods.

clauses.title: Manage: risks prioritized and acted on
clauses.text: AI risks shall be prioritized, treated and monitored on an ongoing basis, with documented decisions and rationale.

clauses.title: Trustworthy characteristics
clauses.text: AI systems shall be valid, reliable, safe, secure, resilient, accountable, transparent, explainable, interpretable, privacy-enhanced and fair with harmful bias managed.
